title: creTarget: CRISPRi guide RNA design for the noncoding genome
description:
creTarget designs, scores, and ranks CRISPRi guide RNAs for noncoding target regions (SNPs and enhancers) in hg38. It combines FlashFry off-target and on-target scoring with optional CNN-based efficacy prediction, ATAC-seq accessibility annotation, and promoter-proximal seed screening, and scales from a handful of targets to genome-wide libraries through Nextflow.

The Python package is the step-level engine; the Nextflow pipeline is the supported end-to-end interface. Reference data and third-party model checkpoints are fetched explicitly and are not bundled.
notes: creTarget builds on FlashFry, launch-dCas9, and the promoter-proximal seed-screening method of Hartman et al. 2026. See CITATION.cff for the full attribution.
